title: SpatialScene SceneDescription, contract v1.1
description: The 3D Module -> Simulator scene contract, version 1.1 (spec: docs/contract/README.md). This schema expresses everything JSON Schema can express: types, required and unknown fields, ranges, array lengths, enums and emitter counts. The geometric rules are enforced only by the C++ validator (src/contract/Validate.cpp): the listener and every emitter must lie inside the room at least 0.1 m from every surface (E_LISTENER_SURFACE_CLEARANCE, E_EMITTER_SURFACE_CLEARANCE), and every emitter must be at least 0.3 m from the listener (E_EMITTER_TOO_CLOSE_TO_LISTENER). The schema validates documents at minor versions 0 and 1 strictly (1.1 changed only the meaning of render.maxReflectionOrder, not the document structure); a reader of version 1.1 also loads newer 1.x documents and ignores their unknown fields, which this schema does not model. tools/ci/test_schema_agreement.py checks that the schema and the C++ reader agree on every fixture in tests/scenes/.

contractVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Same major as the reader is required; see README 'Versioning'.

units.description: Length unit of every position and dimension. Only metres in v1.

dimensions.description: [W, D, H] in metres. The room occupies [0,W] x [0,D] x [0,H] (AX6: each 1.5-100 m).

emitters.description: AX7: exactly two emitters, ids L and R, channels 0 and 1, each used once.

maxReflectionOrder.description: Highest image-source reflection order of the early-reflection-only (omni ISM) IR. Since 1.1 it has no effect on the hybrid room IR, whose early part holds every image of any order arriving before t_mix + 2.5 ms (BUILD_PLAN AX20); see README.

extensions.description: Free object for editor-only data, preserved in round trips. The Simulator never reads it.

vec3.description: [x, y, z] in metres; x right, y forward, z up (AQ1).

absorption.description: Absorption per octave band at 63, 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000 Hz (AQ3: each 0.01-1.0).
